proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord in types.ts is the union SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. There is no MagicItemRecord. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom and the survey queue contains many magic_item slugs, but the surface type system has no record kind to carry them. No encoding is possible until the record type is added.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The unit slug magic_item_portable_hole has kind='magic_item'. types.ts exports no MagicItemRecord and UnitRecord does not include it.

proposed_widenings.name: toggle_state family (open/close activated object)
proposed_widenings.justification: The Portable Hole has two discrete operational states (open, closed) each reached by a Magic action. Neither the activation (class feature) nor any spell family captures a stateful physical object that persists between activations with toggling open/close semantics. A magic item mechanics family for 'activate to change persistent object state' is missing.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to unfold a Portable Hole... You can take a Magic action to close a Portable Hole by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up.

proposed_widenings.name: ability_check_gate (DC 10 Strength Athletics)
proposed_widenings.justification: The escape mechanic requires a creature inside to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check — an ability_check resolution with a fixed DC, not a save_gate. The v4 taxonomy has ability_check as a resolution atom but the surface type Effect/ActivationPhase has no ability_check_gate variant analogous to save_gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: a creature within the hole's extradimensional space can take an action to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the creature forces its way out and appears within 5 feet of the Portable Hole.

proposed_widenings.name: transport_exile (extradimensional containment with gate destruction interaction)
proposed_widenings.justification: The Bag-of-Holding interaction creates a one-way gate to the Astral Plane and destroys both items, then forcibly transports all creatures within 10 feet. This is a conditional item-interaction trigger that emits transport_exile, but no mechanism exists in the surface for item-on-item interaction triggers or item destruction effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Placing a Portable Hole inside an extradimensional space... instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane... Any creature within 10 feet of the gate and not behind Total Cover is sucked through it and deposited in a random location on the Astral Plane.

notes: The blocking issue is structural: types.ts has no MagicItemRecord and UnitRecord does not include magic_item as a kind. Even if that type existed, the Portable Hole would require further widening for (1) toggle-state item mechanics family, (2) ability_check_gate surface variant for the escape check, and (3) a conditional item-interaction destruction trigger for the Bag-of-Holding hazard. No Dhall, JSON, or trace files produced.
